decisive_items: a solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone extending along the course of the sciatic nerve
MR neurography confirmed that the mass arose from the sciatic nerve at the left ischial groove
response.rationale: Schwannoma is a more common and well-documented type of nerve sheath tumor compared to neurofibroma and perineurioma, with characteristic imaging findings of a solitary, cystic mass along the course of a nerve

rejected.why: Perineurioma is a less common and less well-documented type of nerve sheath tumor, with less specific imaging findings
Neurofibroma is also a possible diagnosis, but schwannoma is more likely given the characteristic imaging findings
